<!-- One to three sentences: what this means without recent context, which larger outcome it advances, and why now. -->

## Change

<!-- Describe the behavior, contract, or decision that changes. Name what remains outside this PR when useful. -->

<!-- Explain the non-obvious rationale, relevant alternatives, or trade-offs. Delete this section for mechanical changes. -->

<!-- Tests, checks, runtime evidence, research limits, or the evidence required before integration. -->

<!-- Exact next action, blocker, merge/deploy state, or clearing condition. -->
